summary: Iteration 195 frontend-only verification. All 6 requested scenarios PASS. (1) /prr Solution Box tab loads with items and no error panel. (2) /tools/pros-cons-list loads with items and no error panel. (3) /tools/solution-finder-list loads with items and no error panel. (4) Retry-guard: aborting /api/solution-box* before first load renders the LoadErrorState panel with 'Couldn't load your data' and a Retry button; removing interception and tapping Retry restores the list. (5) Same behaviour verified for /api/pros-cons* on Pros & Cons list and /api/solution-finders* on Solution Finder list — error panel appears with retry button, then screen recovers after clicking Retry with interception cleared. (6) Admin Handbook /admin/handbook renders '15 documents available' including System KT, Postman Collection Guide, REST API Reference, Admin User Guide, and Production Deployment Runbook (Live). POSTMAN doc body contains both '126 folders' and '1,316 requests'; Documentation Index header shows 'v3.23.1'. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages surfaced during testing, no console errors beyond a single 404 on a static resource unrelated to the tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: LoadErrorState component is clean, uses testID='load-error-state' + testID='load-error-retry', minimum-44px touch target, proper Text wrapping, and StyleSheet.create — no issues.
All three list screens correctly guard with `loadError && items.length === 0` so a filter that legitimately returns 0 items still renders the empty state (not the error panel) — matches the spec.
pros-cons-list.tsx correctly resets loadError=false inside the try-block on success and in retryFetch; retry semantics are consistent across the three screens.
seed_data_creation: None — existing seed data was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /auth/login (not /login). Inputs use testID login-email and login-password (rendered as data-testid). Solution Box tab lives at /prr (not /(tabs)/prr in URL). LoadErrorState panel uses testID='load-error-state' with retry button testID='load-error-retry'. Admin Handbook lives at /admin/handbook and uses friendly titles for slugs (e.g. 'System KT' not 'SYSTEM_KT'); rely on displayed titles or count '15 documents available' when validating docs list.
